### Memorial Stones
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/memorial-stones
Passage: Joshua 4:23-24
Points:
- Tangible mementos help preserve memory of life's most defining and joyful moments.
- God instructed Israel to establish a twelve-stone monument at Gilgal to remember crossing the Jordan on dry land.
- The stones were intended to spark questions from future children, prompting parents to testify of God's power and foster reverence for Him.
- Believers today are given visible signs in baptism and the Lord's Supper to remember and proclaim God's salvation in Christ.
- Reflecting on God's historical faithfulness continually strengthens the faith of His people.
